description: This file defines API endpoints for managing user profiles in a sports live stream platform backend. It includes functionality for creating, retrieving, updating, searching, and deleting user profiles, using FastAPI with asynchronous SQLAlchemy ORM models.

methods.name: create_user_profile( profile_data: UserProfileCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a new user profile, assigning it a unique ID, and checks for existing profiles before insertion.

methods.name: get_my_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile based on trusted user credentials.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: UserProfileUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data, updating the timestamp.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id( profile_id: str, request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by profile ID, enforcing privacy rules based on owner status.

methods.description: Performs a search over user profiles with filters such as query string, favorite sport, location, and verification status.
